mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.2% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as central bank easing supports risk asset performance.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% signals economic distress that triggers risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced consumer spending confidence.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 8.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand that accelerates corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production decline below 95.0 during late-cycle expansion indicates weakening manufacturing activity, reducing corporate profit margins and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO falls below 95.0 during late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation that triggers central bank tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days due to higher discount rates.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY inflation exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payrolls exceeding 130,000 thousand persons indicates strong labor market conditions that sustain consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS exceeds 130,000.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signal deteriorating supply chain conditions that reduce corporate output and earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in INDPRO and HOUST fails to produce negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth exceeding 2.5% annualized during early-cycle expansion indicates robust demand momentum that accelerates corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.5% annualized during early-cycle expansion.
